claim: Always serialize timestamps in UTC to avoid cross-region comparison bugs
rationale: prior incidents with mixed local/UTC timestamps in order ledger

claim: Bunny Stream Token Authentication broke video loading on static sites — prefer simple client-side gating.js over server-side signing for non-DRM content
rationale: Token Auth added complexity without meaningful protection; gating.js with CSS class .lesson-video proved reliable on 148-page site

claim: Firebase auth-core.js must use absolute path /js/auth-core.js (not relative) and be loaded before </body> (not <head>) on static multi-directory sites
rationale: Relative paths broke on hub pages with different directory depths; absolute path works everywhere

claim: For static education sites with video paywall: use .lesson-video CSS class for gating placeholder and .lesson-video-player for the iframe wrapper — keep gating logic in a single gating.js file
rationale: Pattern proven on 148-page bilingual site; single gating.js with language detection handles both RU (free after login) and EN (subscription required)

claim: Split sensitive API keys into parts (k1 + k2) in client-side JS to avoid automatic secret masking in logs and git diffs — assemble at runtime
rationale: Firebase API key kept getting masked in logs; splitting into two vars solved it without adding server-side complexity

claim: After git push to GitHub Pages custom domain, always verify raw GitHub first. Wait 5-10 minutes before trusting live output. If raw shows the fix but live doesn't, it's a Cloudflare cache delay — NOT a deploy failure. Do NOT re-edit or re-push based on stale live output. If GitHub Pages hasn't rebuilt, trigger with: git commit --allow-empty -m 'trigger: rebuild' && git push origin master
rationale: Cloudflare edge nodes serve stale HTML for 3-10 minutes even after Purge Everything + Development Mode. Re-editing based on stale output wastes time and risks regressions. Raw GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) is the source of truth.
